descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S13 Real phone dictation: traffic shows an ephemeral token only, never a key, and no device speech service

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3a Speech-to-text runs through a BAA-covered, authenticated path, not a direct, unauthenticated call: routed server-side, with no API key in the browser. (UAT OAT-05 step 3; TFA-94423 AC 1)
  • U1a No long-lived provider API key or credential (AWS, OpenAI, Google Vertex service account, Deepgram, SES) is present anywhere in client code: the web bundle and its served source maps, the iOS and And … (UAT OAT-05 step 1; TFA-94700 AC 5; TFA-94700 description ('No API keys client-side … UAT OAT-05 step 1'); TFA-94423 AC 1)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given The TestFlight build on an iPhone and the Play internal build on an Android phone, built against a named non-review deployment (the local stack over LAN or a UAT deployment, never , the store-review backend). …

When Dictate into the Hospital pre-round notes and the Nursing Home encounter. Then drop Wi-Fi mid-dictation and restore it, so the kept recording is recovered. Then, on one phone with automatic time off, set the clock 5 minutes fast and dictate once, set it 1 day back and dictate once, and restore the correct time (3.8).

Then HTTP(S): before each live session the device calls the Convex prepareSession action. The only OpenAI HTTP(S) request is POST /v1/realtime/calls, with an ephemeral client secret (as minted by prepareSession), never a long-lived sk- key. The recovered recording uploads to Convex, not to OpenAI. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 3 and step 1 on iOS and Android, and UAT 3.8 (server time, not device time). A long-lived key in any header, any speech HTTP(S) request that does not go to OpenAI or Convex, recovery audio sent straight to OpenAI, or a wrong-clock phone that cannot dictate or loses the dictation is a Fail, quoted with the host, step and clock offset. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-05/S13

Real phone dictation: traffic shows an ephemeral token only, never a key, and no device speech service

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa); TFA-94700 Physician Settings & AI Consent (store requirements) (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status blocked in newspec-c/results.json → blocked (blocked).

Detail:

Not run: it needs a phone dictating through the live session behind a recording HTTPS proxy and a packet capture; on the local stack a live dictation would ask OpenAI for a realtime client secret, which the brief forbids, and the emulator has no microphone. Our addition (review: record-only is enough). Recorded from the APK built here: its web bundle names only 127.0.0.1:4510/4511 and api.openai.com/v1/realtime/calls, and a scan for key patterns (sk-, AKIA, AIza, xox) found none. Also recorded: test accounts carry the on-device test marker through the shared fixture, and with it the Android app dictates with Android's on-device recogniser (seen as a 'No match' error on the silent emulator) - a test-only path; a physician account (no marker) uses the cloud engine.

Evidence: 0 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android; dictation by microphone/speaker (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Set aside on dev (Quinn 2026-10-14): dictation by microphone, iOS and Android are left out of the dev run, and this dictates on a real iPhone and Android phone behind a recording proxy and a packet capture.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
